podcast.body: Paul Williams is credited with writing this song for Kermit the Frog and The Muppets, showcasing his diverse songwriting career which also includes the "super sappy" 'We've Only Just Begun' for The Carpenters. "the guy who wrote the rainbow connection for Kermit, the frog, and the muppets, not to mention the co-writer of the super sappy. We've only just begun for the Carpenters invented goth music."
